summary: Short, very steep kerb beside an apartment block; not usable.

best_section.where: Bellevue Terrace kerb beside Dover Lodge apartments, at the Dengate Lane corner

drivers.seclusion: Dover Lodge apartments 11 m away on the section's own side; homes all round within 25 m.

drivers.traffic: Busy main road just west; quiet street itself.

sun_shade: Apartment block shades the north side; trees to the east.
